description: Expander for Slide, sitting immediately to its right: it gives each of the eight strings its own gate jack, velocity jack and audio jack

params.text: Sets that string's velocity when its own velocity jack is empty, and attenuates the jack when one is patched

inputs.text: A rise picks that string on its own
Sets that string's velocity, 0-10V, in place of its knob

outputs.text: That string's sound on its own jack

notes: nothing here has any effect until a Slide is placed immediately to the left; there are no cables between them
the eight audio outputs are where a Slide's per-string sound is taken from at all: the parent module's own per-string output was retired when this expander arrived

inputs.9:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob beside it; a negative voltage does nothing here.
